reason: The visible AUTO Portfolio Active Positions card in App.js does not contain an exit button. The older runtime only targeted a separate legacy Active Paper/Live Trade card, so installing that hook earlier still did not add a control to the actual card the user was viewing.

required_checks: Manual Trade Exit panel is injected into both Trade and Bot screen ScrollViews
Every open trade receives a separate EXIT THIS TRADE button
Confirmation identifies symbol, quantity and live price
Manual exit POST sends only the selected trade_id
The panel refreshes open trades every three seconds
No automatic strategy or execution rules are changed
JavaScript syntax and Android Metro export
validation.root_cause: The actual AUTO Portfolio Active Positions JSX rendered trade details and P&L but no TouchableOpacity or manual-exit action. The previous patch targeted a different legacy card signature.
validation.ui_fix: Add a screen-level Manual Trade Exit panel at the top of both Trade and Bot screens, independent of the legacy card replacement. The panel stays visible as an update marker and shows per-trade red exit buttons whenever an open trade exists.
validation.data_behavior: Open trades are normalized from trade history, trade-live and bot signal payloads. Each button is tied to that trade's id and refreshes after the server confirms exit.

trade_safety: Explicit user-requested manual exit UI only. No signal, score, entry, automatic exit, quantity, stop-loss, cooldown, capital allocation, broker or order-placement rule changes.
